items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: I used to go there with my oldest brother, called Joseph Piper

ctx.x: She used to make catechism school, white and colored at times. See, these nine, you know what I'm saying? And catechism, and take communion and everything. Then I used to go to the sister on Alley Street, called the mother of the sister, called Set-by-Morch. She's dead, there'd be some years back. And I used to go there with my oldest brother, called Joseph Piper, sometimes ring that bell. You know, children used to be double, and they'd ring the bell and run. So I run, I done it one day, and the sister come out…
